title: Wave 6b: The night
summary: Wave 6b of web/spec/README.md section 7 at integration: Observe Run mode (the live light curve under the image with the run's mini charts), the drawer's curve tools in its tab row, the Field band without its empty strip, Watch, the attention system (server rules, status-bar chip and list, Run card items, Watch row, Web Audio tones Off / Soft / Normal), keep-awake (caffeinate held only during a run, the preflight row), the end-of-night wrap-up with tonight's calibration, one curve per star and filter (S49) with the plan warning, the draft's start time and the Stellarium refusal toast. Against the headless server in simulator replay mode on APFS clones of real RR Lyr raw frames (2026-09-25, frames 1-20 and 146-152, 146-165 for the fixer's re-captures of 2026-11-14 after the reviews; Settings site replaced by public Paris coordinates; check star 000-BJW-666 assigned on the copies): the HFD rise fires at frame 150 as the science review's replay says, is heard, acknowledged from another client and clears; the Run band equals the server's points. Device scale 1; 23 scenes in the three themes at 1 440 x 900 and in Observatory at 1 280 x 800 (the Stellarium toast and the LP curve in Observatory 1 440 only).
